purpose: Collect real-learner usability, comprehension, diagnostic-transfer and retention signals for MouldMaster without presenting an exploratory pilot as efficacy or psychometric validation.

cohort.eligibility: Adults using the app voluntarily for injection-moulding learning; no customer or employer identity is required in the repository evidence.

design.baseline: Short pre-use concept and diagnostic task set before guided learning.
design.immediate: Repeat matched concept/diagnostic tasks after the assigned learning path and Book use.
design.delayed: Repeat matched transfer tasks after 7-14 days where feasible.
design.qualitative: Capture confusion points, navigation friction, perceived confidence and the reason for any answer changes.
bookTasks: find the applicable Book chapter for a defect or process question
state the chapter's applicability boundary before acting
distinguish a plausible mechanism from a guaranteed cause
identify when machine/material/mould/site documentation overrides generic guidance
guidanceProgression: novice: worked support with explicit evidence-chain prompts
developing: partial guidance; learner commits to mechanism and test before explanation
advanced: evidence-only challenge before guidance is revealed

analysisBoundary: This pilot may identify usability and learning-signal opportunities. It does not by itself establish efficacy, accreditation, population psychometric validity, production recipe validity or machine-control authority.

privacy.publicRepositoryEvidence: Aggregate counts, non-identifying analysis references and release-bound conclusions only.

promotionRule: data/release-external-validation-v1.json learnerOutcomes must remain hold until a separately reviewed real-learner longitudinal evidence object satisfies tools/verify_release_external_validation.py.

primaryEndpoints.immediateLearningGain: Paired change from baseline to immediate matched concept/diagnostic performance.
primaryEndpoints.delayedTransferRetention: Performance on novel matched transfer tasks after the governed delay window, analysed separately from immediate gain.
primaryEndpoints.diagnosticReasoning: Rubric score for baseline/evidence/mechanism/test/verification reasoning rather than answer accuracy alone.
primaryEndpoints.boundaryRecognition: Ability to identify when generic Book guidance must yield to machine/material/mould/site documentation and when evidence is insufficient.

secondaryEndpoints.evidenceNavigation: Time to locate relevant evidence without coaching.
secondaryEndpoints.calibration: Confidence versus correctness; confidence is not treated as competence.

analysisRules: Keep baseline, immediate and delayed outcomes distinct; do not collapse them into one headline score.
Report paired change and uncertainty intervals where the data support them; do not use a p-value alone as an efficacy claim.
Report attrition and missing delayed reviews explicitly rather than analysing completers as if they represented the full cohort.
Stratify descriptively by prior experience when cell sizes permit; do not infer population differences from tiny subgroups.
Novel transfer tasks must not simply repeat the original answer wording.
A learner-outcomes PASS requires separately reviewed real-participant evidence; synthetic, automated, proxy or developer-run results never satisfy it.

measures: item difficulty by stable question ID and revision
item discrimination against an independently defined total/criterion score where sample size and design justify it
prohibitions: No psychometric validity claim from synthetic traffic, automated browsers or developer test accounts.
No fixed competence cut-score validation from the current exploratory pilot.
No item-level discrimination estimate is reported as stable without a pre-specified adequate real-response sample and independent review.
psychometricPlan.nextGate: Collect an adequately sized real-response calibration cohort under data/psychometric-validation-plan-v1.json before using item statistics, cut scores or credential claims operationally.
